title: These New GTA 6 Clips Look So Real, Fans Can't Believe It's All In-Game Footage
text: These New GTA 6 Clips Look So Real, Fans Can't Believe It's All In-Game Footage | Push Square Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Push Square News Reviews Features Videos Games PS Plus Guides Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 GTA These New GTA 6 Clips Look So Real, Fans Can't Believe It's All In-Game Footage #OnlyinViceCity by Stephen Tailby 1 hour ago Share: Update [ Thu 12th Nov 2026, 5pm ]: Another GTA 6 video has gone live from onlyindade , and it too has a strikingly realistic look. Here it is, with the clip focusing on several vehicles in a police escort: This rollout made us do a double take 👀 #ONLYinViceCity pic.twitter.com/fPXyfcOR1B - ONLY in DADE (@ONLYinDADE) November 12, 2026 The signpost in the upper left features in-game locations, confirming that this is also in-game capture — though it's definitely aiming to ape reality. Here's a direct comparison with real life: GTA 6 vs REAL LIFE: pic.twitter.com/vqgNVqDMSY - GTA 6 Updates (@gtasix_) November 12, 2026 It's all pretty impressive stuff. Original Story: If you're at all interested in GTA 6 , you'll probably have seen this doing the rounds already. A video is going viral on social media, because it's fooling people into thinking it's real-life footage — but it's actually the game. Here's the clip in question: BREAKING: NEW GTA 6 gameplay footage JUST DROPPED. Confirmed by Rockstar Games. pic.twitter.com/RsXST3C6t6 - GTA 6 Updates (@gtasix_) November 11, 2026 Originally posted by onlyindade on Instagram , the video has since been shared by the official Rockstar Games account, with many taking that as confirmation it's actually a video of Vice City within GTA 6. The clip begins with a view from inside a moving vehicle as it drives past the Cortez Hotel, a Vice City location inspired by the real world Colony Hotel in Miami. The view flips half-way through, looking out onto the road. We see several custom cars (the same ones that have been recreated in real life ) as well as an impressive number of NPCs going about their business. It's extremely convincing; the way the camera sways mimics the sort of videos captured on smartphones. You can actually see a direct comparison of the video against real life here: Real Life VS GTA 6 gameplay This game is reaching uncanny valley levels of realism pic.twitter.com/Y6ZZR5lGB2 - NikTek (@NikTek) November 11, 2026 Fans are getting really excited about this new clip as it really highlights the game's attention to detail and realism, with some still unconvinced it's actually GTA 6.
